page.layout: One blank page: a sheet of pale, creased parchment-like paper or a binding leaf with no printed text. Dark background at the edges belongs to the scan.
page.notes: The scan shows a blank leaf with only creases, staining and show-through. No printed text, no running head, no page number, no catchword or signature is visible. A faint small mark near the lower left is a stain, not a printed character.
